landing.heroTitle: Stop losing leads and manage your entire business
landing.heroSubtitle: CRM, HR and marketing automation combined to help you get more customers and stay organized. The all-in-one business software you've been looking for.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Bring all your business processes into one intuitive system. Save time and get better overview.
landing.featureCrmDesc: Manage leads, deals and customer relationships. Follow the sales process from start to finish.
landing.featureHrDesc: Handle employee data, absence, payroll and recruitment in one system.
landing.featureInvoiceDesc: Create invoices, track payments and get overview of your finances.
landing.featureCalendarDesc: Plan meetings, events and deadlines with team calendar and reminders.
landing.featureTasksDesc: Assign tasks, set deadlines and track progress across projects.
landing.featureInboxDesc: Unified communication with customers and colleagues directly in the platform.
landing.featureMarketingDesc: Meta Ads management, campaign creation and AI-generated ad content.
landing.featureAiDesc: Your personal PA that helps with everything from emails to reports.
landing.test1text: We switched from 4 different systems to one. The time savings are enormous and our team finally has full overview.
landing.test2text: The HR module makes absence, payroll and onboarding a breeze. We've halved our admin time.
landing.test3text: The pipeline overview and AI recommendations have boosted our close rate by 35%.
landing.faq1q: What is included in the price?
landing.faq1a: Everything. CRM, HR, Invoicing, Task Management, Calendar, Inbox, AI features and API access are all included in one price per user.
landing.faq2q: Can I import data from other systems?
landing.faq2a: Yes, we support CSV import of leads, customers and employee data. You can also use our API for automatic integration.
landing.faq3a: We use enterprise-grade encryption, daily backups and fully comply with GDPR. Your data is hosted in the EU.
landing.faq4a: No, you can cancel anytime. No commitment, no hidden fees.
landing.faq5q: What happens to my data if I cancel?
landing.faq5a: You can export all your data before cancellation. We delete your data within 30 days after cancellation in accordance with GDPR.
landing.pricingSubtitle: One price. All features. No hidden fees.
landing.pricingDesc: Full access to all modules and features. Scale up and down as needed.
landing.pricingNote: 14-day free trial. No demo calls. Full access from day one.
